contact.evidence_quote: As of July 1, 2024 Estonian Defence Forces and national defence organisations are led by the Commander of the Defence Forces, Lieutenant General Andrus Merilo. ... Lieutenant General Andrus Merilo was born on 2 June 1973. He started his military service in 1992 as a conscript in the Kuperjanov Infantry Battalion. He continued his service in the Estonian Infantry Company of the Baltic Battalion.
